Author: Juvvadi Sridevi

entities.text: Naikoti Rakesh Datta vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Bench: Juvvadi Sridevi
 Hon'Ble Smt. Justice Juvvadi Sridevi
 I.A.Nos.1 and 2 of 2024
 in/and
 Criminal Petition No.13479 of 2024
Common Order:

This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 528 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhitha, 2023 by the petitioner/accused to quash the proceedings against him in C.C.No.1297 of 2024 on the file of XI Additional Metropolitan Magistrate, Cyberabad at Rajendranagar, Ranga Reddy District registered for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 354, 420 of IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act,
2.

entities.text: Additional Metropolitan Magistrate, Cyberabad at Rajendranagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
It is submitted by learned counsel appearing for the petitioners as well as the respondent No.2,
that during pendency of the present Criminal Petition, the parties have compromised the matter and accordingly, I.A.Nos.1 and 2 of 2024 have been filed to record the compromise between them and to compound the offences.
3.

Vide order dated 08.11.2024, this Court directed the parties along with their respective counsel to appear before the Secretary, High Court Legal Services Committee, High Court for the State of Telangana, Hyderabad, for identification and to submit a report.

entities.text: High Court Legal Services Committee, High Court for the State of Telangana, Hyderabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
4. Pursuant to the above said direction issued by this Court, the parties have appeared and the Secretary, High Court Legal Services Committee, has identified the parties and submitted a report,
dated 03.12.2024 and the same is placed on record.
5.
In view of the above, I.A.Nos.1 and 2 of 2024 are allowed.

Consequently, this Criminal Petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioner/accused in C.C.No.1297 of 2024 on the file of XI Additional Metropolitan Magistrate, Cyberabad at Rajendranagar, Ranga Reddy District, are hereby quashed.

entities.text: Additional Metropolitan Magistrate, Cyberabad at Rajendranagar, Ranga Reddy District
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Miscellaneous applications, if any pending, shall stand closed.
